retained_leads.summary: Yale catalogue introduction names a seal impressed on a Gungunum-year-10 tablet. Entry1090 identifies YBC5447, describes seated drinking figures and intervening motifs, and distinguishes a separate Failaka drawing1090d. The entry refers to Hallo and Buchanan in AS16 and Buchanan1967 Archaeology20 pages104-107.

retained_leads.summary: A search snippet combined fragments mentioning an unmistakable Indus character and the Yale tablet. It did not establish that both belonged to the same article or object. Follow-up search located the character phrase as a quotation attributed to Gadd no7, IM8028, a different object. The apparent Yale-script statement was not accepted.

scope: Search results locate evidence; original Parpola and Ricetti pages were separately checked. No search snippet is treated as a deciphered Indus inscription. Other unrelated and speculative rebus hits were not used as semantic evidence.
